purpose: Third-party systems that emit events over HTTP webhooks or to the sources Kafka cluster
Separate Kafka cluster with source.* topics; third-party systems publish, only ingest consumes
Source adapters: receive a payload, stamp event_id, source_id and received_at, enqueue it
Kafka topic events.raw: durable buffer of raw events, keyed by source_id
Applies schema mappings (parks unmapped events until one arrives), matches rules, deduplicates, owns alert state, auto-resolves quiet alerts
Kafka topic alerts.changes: alert state changes, keyed by alert_id
Kafka topic config.changes: compacted stream of rules, mappings, sources, teams, preferences and runbooks, keyed by kind:id
Kafka topic alerts.timeline: timeline entries written by services other than the API, keyed by alert_id
Kafka topic schema.samples: one sample payload per schema no mapping matched, keyed by fingerprint
Notification policy, outbox with retry and fallback, channel adapters, escalation, digests
Delivery targets, mocked: MailHog SMTP and a logging SMS and call gateway
Alert counters and offsets already counted; pub/sub channel ui.alerts for live UI updates
Ingest's own Postgres: its copy of source configs
Processor's own Postgres: alerts, incidents, outbox, parked unmapped events, and its copies of mappings, rules and the service map
Notifier's own Postgres: notification outbox and its copies of alerts, rules, teams, on-call, preferences, runbooks
API's own Postgres: all configuration, runbooks, timeline, action runs, proposals, and a read copy of alerts
AI worker's own Postgres: its job queue (schema samples, runbook drafts and resolved alerts to process)
REST and WebSocket for the UI: owns configuration, ack and resolve, timeline, runbook lookup, action runner with approval
Live alert feed, alert card with runbook and timeline, rule editor, channel preferences
Off the event path: an LLM agent that writes mappings for new schemas, converts runbooks, and proposes a runbook from a resolved alert's timeline
LLM API called by the AI worker only, never per event

data: rules, mappings, sources, teams, preferences, runbooks
config, timeline, action runs, alert copy
sample payload, runbook text, alert timeline
